concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑015 (definition of a lead‑free candidate and true‑positive rule) is not referenced in any phase or task table. The plan discusses false‑negative rates for lead‑free identification but never cites FR‑015, leaving the requirement unbacked.
Phase 11 – Reporting is listed without any associated FR or SC identifiers. The spec does not mandate a dedicated reporting phase, so this element is an over‑reach beyond the documented requirements.
